function drawShelves(){

// Their front glass is separated from the wall by standard floor tiles.

if(tile(x,1)==='Ф'){

stockDraw(sprite,dx,dy,w,h);
}
}
}

for(const g of shelfClusters()){
if(g.h>=3 && g.w<=2){
// Whole vertical fixture: one metal body per row, real artwork with a
// top cap, stocked intermediate sections and only one bottom endcap.
for(let xx=g.x;xx<g.x+g.w;xx++){
let yy=g.y;
while(yy<g.y+g.h){
if(!isShelfTile(xx,yy)){yy++;continue;}
const y0=yy;while(yy<g.y+g.h&&isShelfTile(xx,yy))yy++;

for(let p=0;p<seq.length;p++){

}

}else if(g.h===1&&g.w>=2){

const theme=[4,7].includes(g.y)?'auto':g.y===10?'powder':'diapers';

// centered within the 4-cell row and kept un-stretched proportionally.

const im=STOCK_V056_IMG[sprite];
if(im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth){
const w=3.55*TILE;
const h=w*im.naturalHeight/im.naturalWidth;
const dx=g.x*TILE+(g.w*TILE-w)/2;
const dy=g.y*TILE+(TILE-h)/2;
stockDraw(sprite,dx,dy,w,h);
}
}else{
// Any other horizontal stock rows retain the previous behavior.
for(let x=g.x;x<g.x+g.w;x++)if(isShelfTile(x,g.y))

}else if(g.h<=2 && g.w<=2 && g.w*g.h>1){

}else{

for(const [x,y] of g.cells)stockDraw('bin_single',x*TILE,y*TILE,TILE,TILE);
}
}

function normalizeCheckouts(m){

const lanes=[5,8,11,14,17,20];

// two-cell-wide entrance corridor, not decorative art over walkable tiles.

m.tiles[19][21]='К'; m.tiles[20][21]='К';
m.tiles[19][22]='Р'; m.tiles[20][22]='Р';

m.tiles[19][27]='Р';
m.tiles[18][28]='Р';
m.tiles[19][28]='Р';
